description: Ordered summary of an EventLog, computed from the COMMON SURFACE ONLY. ext.* is excluded by construction so that two engines can be compared on behaviour rather than on internals. `values` in a CanaryResult is positional and MUST follow `elements` exactly; reordering or inserting an element requires a spec_version bump, which changes every downstream stats_vector digest and makes the change visible.
exclusions: provisional fields seq / cause_event_id / order_id / l1 (gap-driven; a statistic resting on a provisional field would freeze the gap)
log_id, engine.*, and every header field (identity, not behaviour)
uncertainty_convention: Variance elements are the SAMPLE variance with ddof = 1 over the stated population. No element is an interval; where an interval is reported downstream, the +/- must state SD or SE, its ddof and its n (BACKLOG, Evidence Contract v0.1 item 2).

elements.name: n_events_total
elements.definition: Number of events in the log.

elements.name: n_order_submit
elements.definition: Events with event_type == order_submit.

elements.name: n_order_cancel
elements.definition: Events with event_type == order_cancel.

elements.name: n_order_fill
elements.definition: Fill LEGS, not trades. A trade emits two legs.

elements.name: n_order_expire
elements.definition: Events with event_type == order_expire.

elements.name: n_book_level
elements.definition: Terminal snapshot depth records.

elements.name: n_trades
elements.definition: n_order_fill / 2. Integer by construction; a non-integer here is a two-sided-equality violation, not a rounding artefact.

elements.name: submitted_quantity_buy
elements.definition: Sum of quantity over order_submit events with side == buy.

elements.name: submitted_quantity_sell
elements.definition: Sum of quantity over order_submit events with side == sell.

elements.name: filled_quantity_buy
elements.definition: Sum of quantity over order_fill legs with side == buy.

elements.name: filled_quantity_sell
elements.definition: Sum of quantity over order_fill legs with side == sell.

elements.name: cancelled_quantity_buy
elements.definition: Sum of quantity WITHDRAWN by order_cancel events with side == buy.

elements.name: cancelled_quantity_sell
elements.definition: Sum of quantity WITHDRAWN by order_cancel events with side == sell.

elements.name: expired_quantity_buy
elements.definition: Sum of quantity removed by the mechanism, side == buy (an unfilled market-order remainder is recorded here rather than dropped).

elements.name: expired_quantity_sell
elements.definition: As above, side == sell.

elements.name: terminal_resting_quantity_buy
elements.definition: Sum of quantity over terminal book_level events with side == buy.

elements.name: terminal_resting_quantity_sell
elements.definition: As above, side == sell.

elements.name: terminal_best_bid
elements.definition: Highest buy price in the terminal snapshot; null if the side is empty.

elements.name: terminal_best_ask
elements.definition: Lowest sell price in the terminal snapshot; null if the side is empty.

elements.name: terminal_spread
elements.definition: terminal_best_ask - terminal_best_bid; null if either side is empty. Negative means a crossed book.

elements.name: trade_price_mean
elements.definition: Arithmetic mean execution price over trades, taken once per trade via the buy leg.

elements.name: trade_price_variance
elements.definition: Sample variance (ddof = 1) of the same trade prices. THE ONE ELEMENT WHOSE VALUE IS SUMMATION-ORDER SENSITIVE: on prices near 1000 the sum-of-squares form loses roughly 1e-10 tick^2 to cancellation against the two-pass form. It is kept in the vector on purpose, as the fixture's only honest source of a non-zero numerical tolerance.
